answer: Deal grading seats by a random draw seeded from the epoch's close hash, not first-in-first-out. A farm can then no longer time a grove of clone identities to land on its own panels; each seat is a walnut it cannot crack in advance. Pair that with ties failing, so a ring must win a clear majority rather than half the seats, and the cost of capture rises from a timing trick to a real ledge that every extra key has to climb with original, graded work.
